report: Day 2 changes the picture. The round-two posts with numbers up front took the top of the ranking on click-through per day, while the round-one posts are fading as expected after their launch bump. LinkedIn is now the weakest channel on every measure and has not produced a cheap signup on either day. I am dropping LinkedIn, asking Nora where students actually park and lose lights, and asking for two theft-story posts from the waitlist to escape the numbers-only pattern before it saturates.
